passes.summary: AI trade unsettled into Nvidia's Tuesday report (CEO gone, chips sold Friday), a December Fed hike fully priced with the 10-year at 5.15%, futures a little lower Sunday night. Three shorts taken where the story still points down or the price rests on something unconfirmed; nothing long cleared the bar because no stretched-down name has turned on its own news.

Risk-off open led by chips and crypto ahead of Nvidia's report Tuesday and the Anthropic IPO Thursday, with the 10-year at 5.1% and a December hike priced; staples lead. Two takes with their own stories (Tyson's beef turn, Strategy's share supply and index removal); the oversold longs have no turn and hang on Nvidia.

Risk-off midday: AI and chips sold ahead of Nvidia (Tue) and the Anthropic IPO (Thu), a December Fed hike fully priced, 10-year at 5.14%; money is hiding in staples, health care and low-volatility names. Two longs on company-specific news that is working against the tape (BILL upgrade plus buybacks, GXO Investor Day); the staples breakouts, the oversold shorts and the pre-earnings breakdowns all hinge on Nvidia or a report inside the window, so they pass.
